column3: Kirino Route · There's No Way My Little Sister Won't Listen To Her Best Friend
...So that's why, please remind her about the time when we gave her the EX Meruru figurine as a gift.
What's with the "So that's why"? I haven't even heard any explanations yet...
Tch, as expected of a secret heroine, you won't be easily led by me.
W-Who's a secret heroine!
Geez... Do you want me to block your phone number again?
Of course not. My bad.
Ahh, I remembered what happened a year ago...
I patched up things between Kirino, who got her otaku hobbies exposed, and Ayase. Yet, I was the only one being treated as the criminal, and my
phone number was blocked by Ayase...
Say, why are your eyes tearing up?
I took the blame for your sake... But that doesn't matter now.
Good grief...
Then, how about letting me hear your explanation? I've already told Kirino about the EX Meruru incident.
...On a side note, Kirino forbade me to tell Ayase about her memory loss.
Well, I do agree with her from my perspective.
That's because Ayase hates Kirino's otaku hobbies. If she were to find out that the current Kirino has forgotten about that, she'll definitely try her best to
prevent her from recovering her memories.
Ahh, actually, it seems that Kirino has entirely forgotten about that matter...
Lies... Something like forgetting about my gift for you... It's a lie, isn't it?
Uh, well... that is...
W-When did Ayase move behind Kirino!? And furthermore, she's putting her face very close to Kirino!!
Y-You... say something!
N-No! It came out wrong!
A-Actually, it's Kirino. She doesn't believe I co-operated with you when choosing the EX Meruru figurine as a gift.
What, so that's how it is.
Of course, Onii-san is lying. I picked EX Meruru on my own, and gave it to Kirino as a gift.
Don't spread such nonsense!!
So she still treats me with hostility as usual...
Ayase, I have a request. Can you please tell me about it?
...*sigh*... A request from Onii-san is one thing, but if it's Kirino's request...
...S-She's finally willing to speak. *sigh* How tiring.
At any rate, Kirino's joy when she received the EX Meruru figurine was really memorable.
